items.title: Implement protected profile credential materialization
acceptance: Opaque credential bytes are written only beneath a validated owner-only profile home.
Nested directories are owner-only and the final credential file is mode 0600 on Unix.
Writes use an exclusive same-directory temporary file, flush, atomic rename, directory sync, and post-write validation.
Bounded rereads reject links, hardlinks, unsafe ownership or permissions, non-files, and oversized content.
All tests use synthetic bytes and real profile commands remain capability-gated.
